highlight.name: KinderQuill
highlight.desc: AI-powered children's storybook generator — age-appropriate stories (Venice text models), Studio Ghibli-style illustrations (qwen-image), and Kokoro TTS narration. Built around the bedtime ritual: daily rotating story prompts, reading streaks, and resume-where-you-left-off. The app that Venice funded — and the one that started everything else.
